_doc: The modular class system's terms: every thing is an expression over primitives (p) and other terms (t). One file for the Godot kernel (commons/modular/composite.gd builds it), the web tree (/knowledge-tree) and the tutorial path (tools/modular_path.py: derivation order = lesson order). Palle, 2026-10-23: 'point + mesh(color) + collider = sphere_collider … everything in this 3d world is triangles'. Primitives: point, mesh{shape,size,color}, collider{shape,size}, body{kind}, grabbable, label{text}, light. Operators: compose{parts}, associate{of,surface,story}, times{of,n,layout}, array{of,n,step,dims}, assemblage{parts[{of,at,rot,scale}]}, engine{of,kind}, transform{of,at,rot,scale}. A part with "scaffold": true is shown while the thing is being built and removed when it is done (Palle: the tape ends alone, line and points gone). A mesh may name a "shader" (ink: the drawn stroke, tapered ends, darker silhouette). {"op":"sort","of":…,"by":size|height|width|name} lays a thing's parts in a row by a reading of each (measure's first operator); {"p":"prefab","token":name} stands a registry artifact in the grammar as itself. {"op":"connect","of":…,"a":i,"b":j,"kind":rope|rod|spring} (or "ties":[[i,j,kind]…]) ties two parts of a thing by index — the strings. `track` lists the main track: each step gives one new capacity (checked by tools/capacity_track.py); every other term and every spine artifact hangs off its nearest step as a branch.

point.label: point
point.expr: point — white on its own, black once it belongs to a line

line.label: line
line.expr: dist(point, point) = length = line — an ink stroke, 4 mm wide

tape.label: tape
tape.expr: line + association(surface: marking tape) — the line is scaffold; the tape stays

triangle_face.label: triangle_base_face
triangle_face.expr: face(3 * edges) — everything in this 3d world is triangles

skateboard.label: skateboard
skateboard.expr: plank + wheel * 4 + connect(two axles, rod) = skateboard — the first of three (skateboard_2, skateboard_3 look more and more like one)

eu_pallet.label: EU pallet
eu_pallet.expr: cube * 9 + plank * 3 + plank * 5 + plank * 3 = EU pallet — the same blocks as the skateboard

tilt_gate.label: tilt gate
tilt_gate.expr: step(plank tilted + sphere_collider, physics) = the ball rolls one way — the beginning of logic

pallet_sorted.label: deconstructed pallet, sorted
pallet_sorted.expr: sort(the pallet taken apart, by size) — measure's first operator

tied_pallet.label: tied pallet
tied_pallet.expr: connect(eu_pallet's top board, bottom board, rope) — the strings

pallet_hand_kit.label: Euro pallet / hand assembly
pallet_hand_kit.expr: 11 planks + 9 blocks → take apart → assemble by hand

handmade_pallet_5d236d1265a1ffe9.label: Pallet / hand-built open frame
handmade_pallet_5d236d1265a1ffe9.expr: Twenty pallet pieces → hand arrangement → reusable loose assemblage

pendulum.label: pendulum
pendulum.expr: step(connect(cube held high + sphere_collider beside it, rope), physics) — the ball falls until the rope is taut, then swings

cylinder.label: cylinder
cylinder.expr: mesh(cylinder) + collider(cylinder) + body — a circle extruded; the engine gives it to us

wheel.label: wheel
wheel.expr: association(cylinder, rubber) = wheel — a cylinder on its side, dressed to roll

deck.label: deck
deck.expr: plank widened + nose + tail + association(grip) = deck — the board a foot can trust

truck.label: truck
truck.expr: association(baseplate + hanger, metal) = truck — the axle and what bolts it to the deck

wheel_54.label: wheel 54 mm
wheel_54.expr: association(cylinder, urethane), 54 mm across, 34 mm wide — the wheel a skateboard really has

skateboard_2.label: skateboard, second
skateboard_2.expr: deck + truck * 2 + wheel_54 * 4 + connect(axles, rod) = skateboard_2 — nose, tail, grip, trucks, urethane

ply.label: ply
ply.expr: one maple veneer, 1.7 mm — a deck is seven of these glued

deck_7.label: seven-ply deck
deck_7.expr: (ply) * 7 stacked + nose + tail + rails + association(grip) = deck_7

bolt.label: bolt
bolt.expr: a 10-32 bolt through deck and baseplate

truck_3.label: truck with kingpin
truck_3.expr: baseplate + kingpin + bushing * 2 + hanger, metal; bolt * 4 through the plate = truck_3

bearing.label: bearing
bearing.expr: association(cylinder, metal), 22 mm — the ring a wheel turns on

wheel_3.label: wheel with bearings
wheel_3.expr: wheel_54 + bearing * 2 = a wheel that turns on something

skateboard_3.label: skateboard, third
skateboard_3.expr: deck_7 + truck_3 * 2 + wheel_3 * 4 + connect(axles, rod) = skateboard_3 — seven plies, kingpins, bushings, bearings, eight bolts

cone_field.label: field of cones
cone_field.expr: by(array(plastic_cone, 4 × 4), random: jitter, turn) = cone_field — a prefab field; walk between them

net.label: net
net.expr: connect(array(sphere_collider, 6 × 6), every neighbour, rope) = net — 36 knots, 60 strings; under physics it drapes over what is below

net_over_cube.label: net over a cube
net_over_cube.expr: step(block 0.8 m + net above it, physics) — the net falls, rests on the block and its margins hang: it follows the outline

curtain.label: curtain
curtain.expr: step(net hung from a row of points, physics) = curtain — the top row is pinned, the rest hangs and swings

bead_chain.label: bead chain
bead_chain.expr: step(connect(point + sphere_collider * 7, each to the next, rope), physics) = bead_chain — hangs from the point, swings as one

ball.label: ball
ball.expr: a red ball, 10 cm — the signal of a marble machine

brick.label: brick
brick.expr: a 12 cm block — a thing in the way

domino.label: domino
domino.expr: a plank on edge, 30 cm — it stands until something tips it

or_frame.label: OR gate (frame)
or_frame.expr: the static parts of OR gate

or_gate.label: OR gate
or_gate.expr: step(funnel with end walls + ball? at A + ball? at B, physics) — a ball from either side reaches the bin: out = A or B

and_frame.label: AND gate (frame)
and_frame.expr: the static parts of AND gate

and_gate.label: AND gate
and_gate.expr: step(cup + ball? at A + ball? at B, physics) — the cup holds one; the second spills: out = A and B

not_frame.label: NOT gate (frame)
not_frame.expr: the static parts of NOT gate

not_gate.label: NOT gate
not_gate.expr: step(ramp + run + ball + brick? at A, physics) — the ball always runs, unless something is in the way: out = not A

branch_frame.label: IF / ELSE (frame)
branch_frame.expr: the static parts of IF / ELSE

branch_gate.label: IF / ELSE
branch_gate.expr: step(roof + ball at left? or right?, physics) — if the ball lands left of the ridge it ends left, else right

domino_frame.label: domino line (frame)
domino_frame.expr: the base and the push ramp of the domino line

domino_line.label: domino line
domino_line.expr: step(ramp + domino * 8 + ball? at push, physics) — one push and a wave runs to the end: a delay line

box.label: box (seen, not touched)
box.expr: mesh(box) = box — a visible solid with no boundary: the eye stops at it, the hand passes through

falling_cube.label: falling cube
falling_cube.expr: step(cube, physics) = falling_cube — the boundary acquires mass: it falls

cube_row.label: a row of cubes
cube_row.expr: array(cube, 4, 1d) = cube_row — the same cube, counted

lattice.label: lattice
lattice.expr: array(box, 6, 3d) = lattice — 216 boxes: repetition at the scale of a material

exhibit_cube.label: cube, exhibited
exhibit_cube.expr: exhibit(cube) — the same cube with a label, a lamp and an area that senses you: staging, not a new principle

pentagon.label: pentagon
pentagon.expr: line * 5 (polygon) = pentagon — five edges close a face

octahedron.label: octahedron
octahedron.expr: triangle_face * 8 = octahedron — four triangles meet at every corner

icosahedron.label: icosahedron
icosahedron.expr: triangle_face * 20 = icosahedron — five triangles meet at every corner

dodecahedron.label: dodecahedron
dodecahedron.expr: pentagon * 12 = dodecahedron — three pentagons meet at every corner

platonic_solids.label: the five Platonic solids
platonic_solids.expr: tetrahedron + cube + octahedron + dodecahedron + icosahedron = the Platonic solids — every face the same regular polygon, every corner the same

moved_cube.label: moved cube
moved_cube.expr: transform(cube, at 0.7) = moved_cube — translation: where it is

turned_cube.label: turned cube
turned_cube.expr: transform(cube, rot 45) = turned_cube — rotation: which way it faces

scaled_cube.label: scaled cube
scaled_cube.expr: transform(cube, scale 1.6) = scaled_cube — scale: how big it is

combined_move.label: combined move
combined_move.expr: transform(cube, at 0.5,0.35,0.4) = combined_move — translation along x, y and z at once, orientation kept

trs_cube.label: translate, rotate, scale
trs_cube.expr: transform(cube, at, rot, scale) = trs_cube — the three in one: where, which way, how big

travelling_cube.label: travelling cube
travelling_cube.expr: tween(cube, at 1.2) = travelling_cube — a place becomes a journey: the destination, played over time

turning_cube.label: turning cube
turning_cube.expr: tween(cube, rot 180) = turning_cube — a turn becomes a turning

growing_cube.label: growing cube
growing_cube.expr: tween(cube, scale 1.8) = growing_cube — a size becomes a growing, and a shrinking

disco_grid.label: a grid with a clock
disco_grid.expr: by(array(sphere, 5, palette by checker), sine_field) = disco_grid — the counted grid, coloured by address, set going by a clock

rainbow_row.label: rainbow row
rainbow_row.expr: array(cube, 7, 1d, palette rainbow) = rainbow_row — the counted row, a colour for each count

color_grid.label: colour grid pallet
color_grid.expr: array(box, 4, palette 4) = color_grid — a fixed span repartitioned by a chosen palette

color_nails.label: colour nails
color_nails.expr: array(nail, 7, 1d, palette 3) = color_nails — familiar forms given a palette regardless of where they stand

alpha_steps.label: alpha steps
alpha_steps.expr: array(pane, 5, 1d, palette alpha) = alpha_steps — visibility thins while the pane still blocks the way

checker_tiling.label: checker tiling
checker_tiling.expr: array(slab, 6, palette 2 by checker) = checker_tiling — a two-value pattern read by address

stripe_tiling.label: stripe tiling
stripe_tiling.expr: array(slab, 6, palette 3 by row) = stripe_tiling — the same slabs, another address rule

reflection_tiling.label: reflection tiling
reflection_tiling.expr: array(quad, 3) = reflection_tiling — a mirrored unit repeated: the reflection travels with the tile

star_tiling.label: rotation tiling
star_tiling.expr: array((triangle_face) * 4 ring, 3) = star_tiling — a unit turned four ways, then repeated

rate_steps.label: a finite rate
rate_steps.expr: array(box, 8, 1d, profile ramp) = rate_steps — a constant rate: each step rises the same amount

accumulation.label: accumulation
accumulation.expr: array(box, 9, 1d, profile sin) = accumulation — height-times-width samples of one smooth function

parabola_arch.label: the arch
parabola_arch.expr: array(box, 9, 1d, profile parabola) = parabola_arch — up then down: net change zero, total travel not

arrow.label: arrow
arrow.expr: line + cone = arrow — a displacement: a length and a direction

vector_sum.label: vector sum
vector_sum.expr: arrow + transform(arrow, at 1, rot 60) + red(arrow, rot 30, scale √3) = vector_sum — head to tail, and the one arrow that does both

launch_arc.label: launch
launch_arc.expr: array(ball, 11, profile parabola, rise 0.9) = launch_arc — equal time steps of a flight under constant acceleration

spring_oscillator.label: spring oscillator
spring_oscillator.expr: step(connect(point + ball, spring), physics) = spring_oscillator — a restoring force: it overshoots, and damping takes the overshoot away

catenary.label: catenary
catenary.expr: step(connect(point + ball × 7 + point, ropes), physics) = catenary — drafted as a parabola, settled by physics into the hanging curve

gradient_descent.label: gradient descent
gradient_descent.expr: point × 13 on a bowl + ball × 6 = gradient_descent — each step goes downhill by a part of the slope; the steps shrink as the slope does

unit_circle.label: unit circle
unit_circle.expr: (point) * 16 circle = unit_circle — round a circle, the height of each point is the sine of its angle

sine_graph.label: sine graph
sine_graph.expr: array(point, 25, profile sin, rise 1) = sine_graph — the heights laid out along time

circle_to_graph.label: the coordinate that draws the graph
circle_to_graph.expr: unit_circle + sine_graph = circle_to_graph — the height of a point going round, drawn out along time

standing_wave.label: standing wave
standing_wave.expr: by(array(ball, 15, 1d), sine_field) = standing_wave — every ball returns; the shape between them stands still

beat_graph.label: beat
beat_graph.expr: array(point, 61, profile beat) = beat_graph — two fast sines summed: a slow envelope neither of them has

ten_print.label: 10 PRINT
ten_print.expr: random(array(line, 8), angles 45/135) = ten_print — one of two diagonals per cell: local choices become a maze

random_sizes.label: random sizes
random_sizes.expr: random(array(box, 6), sizes) = random_sizes — each size thrown on its own: neighbours know nothing of each other

gaussian_bins.label: gaussian bins
gaussian_bins.expr: array(box, 11, profile gauss) = gaussian_bins — sampling, clipping and binning give a record its shape

noise_heights.label: noise heights
noise_heights.expr: by(array(ball, 8), noise) = noise_heights — neighbours share their heights: a field, not a throw of dice

layered_noise.label: layered noise
layered_noise.expr: noise(noise(array(ball, 10), fine), coarse) = layered_noise — two octaves summed: the room wears the sum

sierpinski.label: Sierpiński triangle
sierpinski.expr: recurse(triangle, 3 copies at half size, depth 5) = sierpinski — each generation keeps three corners and removes the middle

cantor_set.label: Cantor set
cantor_set.expr: recurse(bar, two outer thirds, depth 5, every generation) = cantor_set — divided without end: no length left, infinitely many points

fractal_tree.label: fractal tree
fractal_tree.expr: recurse(trunk, keep the trunk, 2 turned copies at 0.68, depth 7) = fractal_tree — a trunk carrying two smaller trees

sierpinski_carpet.label: Sierpiński carpet
sierpinski_carpet.expr: recurse(slab, 8 of 9 cells, depth 3) = sierpinski_carpet — removal at a fixed outer size

phyllotaxis.label: phyllotaxis
phyllotaxis.expr: (point) * 160 phyllotaxis = phyllotaxis — each turned 137.5° from the last: no two in line, the spirals count Fibonacci

lsystem_plant.label: L-system plant
lsystem_plant.expr: rewrite(X: X → F+[[X]-X]-F[-FX]+X; F → FF, 5, 25°) = lsystem_plant — a sentence becomes a plant

dragon_curve.label: dragon curve
dragon_curve.expr: rewrite(FX: X → X+YF+; Y → -FX-Y, 10, 90°) = dragon_curve — a folded strip: the same two rules, never crossing

sierpinski_arrowhead.label: Sierpiński arrowhead
sierpinski_arrowhead.expr: rewrite(F: F → G-F-G; G → F+G+F, 6, 60°) = sierpinski_arrowhead — the same triangle as the recursion, drawn as one line

koch_curve.label: Koch curve
koch_curve.expr: rewrite(F: F → F+F--F+F, 4, 60°) = koch_curve — every segment replaced by four: longer without end, never wider

metaballs.label: metaballs
metaballs.expr: field(1 − Σ r²/d², three centres) = metaballs — three charges, one surface: where the sum crosses one, they merge

gyroid.label: gyroid
gyroid.expr: field(|gyroid| − t ∩ sphere) = gyroid — a minimal surface: one wall dividing space into two linked labyrinths

torus_field.label: torus field
torus_field.expr: field(torus(0.35, 0.12)) = torus_field — the same ring as the mesh, now as distance: every point knows how far it is

noise_blobs.label: noise blobs
noise_blobs.expr: field(noise − t ∩ sphere) = noise_blobs — where the noise rises over a threshold, matter; a porous stone

field_terrain.label: field terrain
field_terrain.expr: field(y − noise) + ground = field_terrain — the surface is also what you stand on

bool_union.label: union
bool_union.expr: field(box ∪ sphere) = bool_union — min of two distances: either is enough

bool_subtract.label: subtract
bool_subtract.expr: field(box − sphere) = bool_subtract — max(box, −sphere): the sphere bores; the far corner stays

bool_intersect.label: intersect
bool_intersect.expr: field(box ∩ sphere) = bool_intersect — max of two distances: only where both are

smooth_union.label: smooth union
smooth_union.expr: field(smin(sphere, sphere, k)) = smooth_union — the min rounded: two become one without a seam

smooth_subtract.label: smooth bore
smooth_subtract.expr: field(−smin(−box, cylinder, k)) + ground = smooth_subtract — a passage bored smoothly: an opening, a support, and a way through

glow_cube.label: glowing cube
glow_cube.expr: association(cube, glow) = glow_cube — bright without being lit: visible brightness is not illumination

rim_sphere.label: rim sphere
rim_sphere.expr: association(sphere, rim) = rim_sphere — the edge brightens toward grazing angles, whatever the light: the view is in the surface

pink_extravaganza.label: pink extravaganza
pink_extravaganza.expr: pink rim cube + glowing sphere + dots = pink_extravaganza — repeated pigment, a view-dependent rim and emission composed on fixed bodies

bush.label: bush
bush.expr: recurse(trunk, keep the trunk, 3 turned copies at 0.62, depth 5) = bush — branching chosen by rule: a tree in three directions

cave_chamber.label: cave chamber
cave_chamber.expr: field(rock − smooth carving centres) + ground = cave_chamber — biased carving leaves a chamber with headroom and a way in

voxel_sphere.label: voxel sphere
voxel_sphere.expr: array(box, 9, 3d, inside sphere) = voxel_sphere — centre-based voxel sampling: a cube stands where its centre is inside

percolation.label: percolation
percolation.expr: random(array(tile, 8), keep 0.6) = percolation — each tile survives a draw; what touches what is left to the lattice

soft_cube.label: soft cube
soft_cube.expr: step(connect(array(ball, 3, 3d), 86 springs), physics) = soft_cube — 27 balls, edges and diagonals: it yields and keeps its relations

boids.label: boids
boids.expr: flock(array(ball, 27), separation + alignment + cohesion) = boids — a flock from three local rules; the movement does not name its cause

graph.label: graph
graph.expr: connect(point × 7, 10 edges) = graph — nodes and edges: which connects to which, nothing more

graph_circle.label: the same graph, another layout
graph_circle.expr: connect((point) * 7 circle, the same edges) = graph_circle — a connection is not a coordinate

spanning_tree.label: minimum spanning tree
spanning_tree.expr: connect(point × 7, 6 of the 10 edges) = spanning_tree — every node reached at least total length (2.96 of 5.12)

grid_graph.label: grid graph
grid_graph.expr: connect(array(point, 4), neighbours) = grid_graph — a lattice read as a graph: reachability through faces

line_fit.label: a line and a loss
line_fit.expr: point × 12 + least-squares line + residuals = line_fit — slope 0.298, intercept 0.523, mean squared error 0.0037

kmeans.label: k-means
kmeans.expr: point × 30, coloured by nearest of 3 centres = kmeans — assignment and means alternated to convergence (2 rounds)

neural_net.label: neural network
neural_net.expr: connect(point 2 + 3 + 1, 9 weights) = neural_net — inputs, a hidden layer, an output: what a weight keeps

track.adds: a hand: it can be taken
a tie: one part holds another
driven motion: a function of time
an assemblage: many kinds of part
a reading: parts in a row by a measure
a decision: inputs become an output
a field: a surface from a function of space
